impact.text: lock that reaches its locked.end loses 100% of rewards for the epoch in which it expires.

precondition_sources.text: A user's lock expires during epoch N, so locked.end <= epochTimestampEnd(N) due to week-rounding.
The user was bonded for part or all of epoch N.

intent_sources.text: The reward calculation must capture the user's non-zero bonded balance at the moment just before lock expiry (locked.end - 1) when the lock expires within the epoch, giving proportional credit for time bonded during that epoch.
